study_identification.title: Structural brain abnormalities and aggressive behaviour in schizophrenia: Mega-analysis of data from 2095 patients and 2861 healthy controls via the ENIGMA consortium

study_characteristics.study_objective: To investigate the association between structural brain abnormalities and aggressive behavior in patients with schizophrenia at an individual level using normative modeling.

quality_checking_detail.answer: The ENIGMA protocols (https://enigma.ini.usc.edu/protocols/), harmonised across sites, were followed for image processing and quality control.

site_effect_handling_detail.answer: Warped Bayesian linear regression with site, sex, age and -for local IDPs only -a global IDP as predictors.

response_variable.answer: Cortical thickness (CT), surface area (SA), and subcortical volumes from T1-weighted scans, and fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) from diffusion-weighted scans.

predictor_variables.answer: site; sex; age; global IDP (for local IDPs)

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Ordinal regression models were used to estimate the associations between deviations and aggressive behaviour. Mediation analyses were performed for positive symptoms, impulse control and illness insight.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Aggressive behaviour was significantly associated with reductions in total cortical volume and global white matter integrity, and these associations were largely mediated by increased severity of positive symptoms and reduced impulse control.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Aggressive behaviour was significantly associated with reductions in total cortical volume (OR [99% CI] = 0.88 [0.78, 0.98], p = .003) and global white matter integrity (OR [99% CI] = 0.72 [0.59, 0.88], p = 3.50 × 10 -5 ) and additional reductions in dorsolateral prefrontal cortex volume (OR [99% CI] = 0.85 [0.74, 0.97], p =.002), inferior parietal lobule volume (OR [99% CI] = 0.76 [0.66, 0.87], p = 2.20 × 10 -7 ) and internal capsule integrity (OR [99% CI] = 0.76 [0.63, 0.92], p = 2.90 × 10 -4 ). Except for inferior parietal lobule volume, these associations were largely mediated by increased severity of positive symptoms and reduced impulse control.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Cross-sectional design, aggression measured at one point in time with single items, potential for inter-item correlations in mediation analysis, no information on comorbid ASPD or psychopathy.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: The findings may inform the development of therapeutic interventions and provide a rationale for investigating whether structural neuroimaging adds to the predictive performance of current risk assessment instruments.

general_notes.general_notes: The study is a mega-analysis of data from 20 sites participating in the ENIGMA-Schizophrenia Working Group.
